likes: genuinely good markets and food halls
neighborhood wine bars where locals go
walking cities: architecture, markets, side streets, parks, waterfronts
easy or moderate nature: drives, lakes, mountains, 1-3 hour walks plus lunch
slow travel, several nights in one place
hotels with good location, quiet room, comfort, access to neighborhoods
morning runs 8-12 km along parks, rivers, waterfronts
dislikes: Michelin or formal dining as a default
tourist-area restaurants with huge menus, aggressive hosts, generic reviews
Italian as the default abroad unless excellent or requested
flashy nightlife and tourist party venues
Top 10 attractions just because they are famous
complicated transport to save a little money

shir.rule: On family trips, always include at least one straightforward restaurant option. Nature is fine; do not make every day a hike.

recommendationRules.count: 2-4 strong choices plus one clear pick
